logline: Two married attorneys face the return of Max Cady, a convicted killer they helped put away, in a psychological thriller that turns legal consequence into domestic siege.

renewal.note: Apple announced Cape Fear as a 10-episode limited series with weekly episodes through July 31, 2026.

seasons.review_body: Nick Antosca reworks Cape Fear as a 10-part psychological horror thriller starring Amy Adams and Patrick Wilson as married attorneys Anna and Tom Bowden, with Javier Bardem as Max Cady. The series draws from both John D. MacDonald's novel The Executioners and the earlier film adaptations, stretching the revenge premise into a weekly domestic siege. Martin Scorsese and Steven Spielberg serve as executive producers. Because the limited series continues through July 31, BollyAI is leaving its score and watch verdict open until the full arc can be judged on complete evidence rather than an unfinished run.
